description: SPACEXPLORATION is a commercial real estate marketplace covering office, retail, industrial, multifamily, and land listings in North America. It also provides building lookup data for US addresses and lets brokers or owners list properties for sale or lease.
summary: spacexploration.com exposes one documented integration surface: a public Streamable-HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` with anonymous read tools and optional OAuth 2.0 bearer-token access for account-bound tools.
